content.text:
I made pressing down on a landed piece restart the lock timer, the same as a sideways move. Left, right and down share the existing limit of 3 restarts per piece. Pressing down on a landed piece no longer counts toward locking it. I updated the locking rule comment to match. Not tested.

I kept the 3-restart limit so a piece still can't be held forever. I rejected giving down its own separate limit. I also rejected letting down still count toward locking once the limit is used up, since a sideways move never does.
